# The Storefront, as operated

The harness that runs the application and ships releases to it. Five services, ~400 MB,
reproducible on a laptop with no AWS account.

```
  web  ──▶  checkout  ──▶  payments  ──▶  psp   (third party, NOT instrumented)
   └──▶  catalog
```

**The application source is not in this repo.** It lives in `../storefront`, generated by
`../build-storefront.sh`, and it is what the agent reads through the GitHub MCP server.
Nothing about the workshop appears there — no incident, no toggle, no answer. Keep it that
way: if you need to change how the system behaves, change it in `storefront-src/` as a
commit that looks like real work.

## Run it

```bash
../build-storefront.sh   # once: generate the app repo and its history
make up                  # deploys v3.1.0; leave it ~10 min to build a baseline
make status              # what the customer is experiencing
make release             # ship the next version of checkout-api
make rollback            # put the previous one back
make psp-slow            # the third-party processor degrades
make down
```

There is no "break it" target. The only mechanism is `make deploy SHA=…`, because a deploy
of a real commit is what actually happens in production. `make release` is that, with the
next release's SHA filled in.

## Where the telemetry goes

By default: into the collector's log and no further — `make traces`. That is enough to do
the whole exercise offline.

To ship it somewhere real, uncomment the `otlp/backend` exporter in `collector.yaml`, add
it to the pipelines, and put the endpoint and headers in `.env`. Swapping backends is that
file and nothing else.

To send everything to a second Bronto org as well, add two lines to `.env`:
`COMPOSE_FILE=docker-compose.yml:docker-compose.mirror.yml` and
`BRONTO_MIRROR_API_KEY=<key>`. That loads `collector.mirror.yaml` on top of
`collector.yaml`. On the shop host, the harness workflow does this when the
`BRONTO_MIRROR_INGEST_KEY` secret is set, and undoes it when the secret is removed.

## Layout

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `docker-compose.yml` | the platform; app services build from `.deploy` |
| `Makefile` | deploy, release, rollback |
| `harness/psp.py` | the third party. Uninstrumented on purpose. |
| `harness/loadgen.py` | customer traffic |
| `.deploy/` | a checkout of the app repo at the deployed SHA (generated) |

**Spoilers.** This directory and `../storefront-src/` give the incident away. If you are
attending the workshop, don't read them.
